I could not open whiskers' profile in the app. The first post in the Following feed is by **whiskers** (@whiskers.test), but this environment has no way to send taps, so I used a deep link instead. That opened `https://bsky.app/profile/whiskers.test` in a browser view, which shows "Oops! Unable to resolve handle." The handle does not resolve here, so no profile page loaded.

The Bluesky app is still open on that error page, not on the Following feed. To finish, someone needs to tap the "whiskers" name or avatar on the first post, or I need a way to send taps to the simulator.
